facts.material: plastics: biaxially oriented polypropylene laminated to PET

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 covers plastic film laminated, supported or similarly combined, noncellular and not reinforced
GRI 3(b): two-polymer laminate, essential character assumed from PET layer

rejected_alternatives.reason: propylene-polymer film; chosen only if the BOPP layer gives the essential character
applies to laminates with aluminum foil or other materials (J80001); not stated

missing_facts: relative thickness/weight of BOPP vs PET layers
whether metallized or used as gift wrap
classification.rationale: Both layers are plastics, so the laminate falls in 3920 and the subheading depends on which polymer gives essential character. PET was assumed; I87495 shows PET film in 3920.62.
